trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. [6][2]
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops on its own. It is the last trophy by definition, so plan the run around the roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. [6][2]

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; nothing else is required for the platinum itself.
Work the roadmap in order — story (S1–S4), side chains (S5), cleanup (S6), money and 100% (S7) — so the platinum lands as soon as the last straggler pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play, and this one is the first of them. [2][3][6]

steps.t: Start the story and play Gone Fishing through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes — no extra objective is needed.
Keep playing into Chapter 1; the next story trophies follow the same way.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1. Do the balcony meditation first — see Positive Mental Attitude. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back. [2][3][1]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission.
Before the chapter ends, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia — the only possibly missable interaction in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which also opens the partner trophies. [2][3]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission.
Use the chapter to start side content that opens here — switching, the Scooter Bros app, Kingpin Bowling — rather than rushing on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The one timing risk in this chapter is Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand: it carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race it as soon as it appears. [2][5]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission.
When Race Against Yago appears (hourglass icon), save first, then race it at once — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank vault robberies — take it when it appears, since vaults feed Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together. [2][3]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it appears — it unlocks the bank vaults.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Before you start it, keep one untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back. [2][3]

steps.t: Before the final mission, make a manual save and leave it untouched.
Play the final mission to the end; the gold pops with it.
After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist unlocks — everything else stays available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It matters beyond its own trophy: switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which is what makes the partner trophies possible. [2][5]

steps.t: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and play it through.
After it, learn the character switch — partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) need it.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. Like every story trophy it unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so just play the story through. [2][5][6]

steps.t: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Play the heist through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops automatically when the mission ends. [2][5][6]

steps.t: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops automatically when the mission ends. [2][5][6]

steps.t: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops automatically when the mission ends. [2][5][6]

steps.t: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It pops automatically when the mission ends. [2][5][6]

steps.t: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.short: The hardest trophy. Reach 100% on the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but progress made earlier already counts. The thresholds are lenient, closer to 60% of everything. [1][3]
trophies.guide: Finish the story first: the 100% checklist only becomes viewable after it, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, though anything you did earlier already counts toward it. The list is lenient — about 60% of true completion — so chase the checklist numbers, not everything in the game: 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons. [1][3][2]

steps.t: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Earlier progress already counts.
Clear the robbery block first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, $250,000 marked bills fenced.
Clear the collectible block: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons.
Clear the activity block: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 30 of 40 races won. Stop at each threshold — the checklist wants less than the full game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.short: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy. [1][2]
trophies.guide: Do any 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 in total. Keep going to 300, because the 100% checklist asks for 300 and A Long Road is the real grind. [1][2][3]

steps.t: Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250.
There are 397 stunts in total, so you only need a little over half of them.
Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind to repeat.
Track progress in the game; the trophy pops at 250.
Do not stop at 250 — the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.short: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. One taste of each is enough. [3]
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, races, bowling, pool, mini golf and the rest. A single try of each type is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything. [3][2]

steps.t: Play one arcade game (also earns Stick Fiddler).
Try fishing once (also feeds Baited My Tackle).
Sample the other types — shooting range, drone race, race, bowling, pool, mini golf — one try each, and the trophy pops at the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.short: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Sources disagree on how many ranges hold them — 2 per OutputLag, 12 per GTAZone — but all agree on 42 golds. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The guides agree on the total of 42 golds but disagree on the range count: OutputLag reports two shooting ranges holding 42 golds between them, while GTAZone counts 42 golds across 12 ranges. Either way, gold every challenge; the 100% checklist also needs all 42. [1][2][3][5]

steps.t: Find a shooting range and work through its challenges, aiming for gold on each.
Repeat a challenge until you hit the gold threshold — silver or bronze does not count.
Sources disagree on the range count (2 per [2], 12 per [5]); trust the in-game counter, not the range count.
Gold all 42 challenges; the trophy pops on the last gold.
The 100% checklist also needs all 42, so this trophy is never wasted effort.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 races in total, and 100% wants all of them. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 races across those locations, and the 100% checklist wants all 42 — so if you are chasing A Long Road anyway, win them all as you go. [2][3][5]

steps.t: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win one race there.
Repeat at each of the other 13 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy.
For 100%, win all 42 races across the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.short: Win 20 different races out of 40. Winning the same race twice does not count. [5]
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 races in total, and repeats do not count — each win has to be a race you have not won before. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won, so keep racing past the trophy. [5][2][3]

steps.t: Enter races across Leonida and win them; each new race won counts once.
Do not grind the same race — a repeat win adds nothing.
The trophy pops at 20 different wins; 100% needs 30 of 40.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon. [5]
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the fishing spot with a purple icon — follow it, fish the challenge, and out-fish him. [5][2]

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 until Cal texts you about fishing.
Follow the purple icon to the marked fishing spot.
Win the fishing challenge against Cal; the trophy pops on the win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.short: Complete any one arcade game. Any of the four in-game games counts. [2]
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. OutputLag reports four in-game arcade games, and any of them counts — pick the one you find easiest and play it through. [2][3]

steps.t: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Pick any of the four in-game games and play it to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends — it also counts as one activity type for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.short: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only. WATCH: one source warns side chains have story-linked windows, so start it as soon as it unlocks. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Play Andy's questline through to its final mission. The strand is Lucia-only, per OutputLag. One source (TechWiser, via eGamers) warns that the stranger chains behind the five hidden side trophies have windows linked to story progress, so start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. [2][4]

steps.t: Start Andy's questline as soon as it unlocks (Lucia-only strand).
Play Andy's missions through in order.
Finish the final mission for Andy; the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.short: Complete the final mission for Kenton. WATCH: one source warns side chains have story-linked windows, so start it as soon as it unlocks. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's questline through to its final mission. One source (TechWiser, via eGamers) warns that the stranger chains behind the five hidden side trophies have windows linked to story progress, so start Kenton's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. [2][4]

steps.t: Start Kenton's questline as soon as it unlocks.
Play Kenton's missions through in order.
Finish the final mission for Kenton; the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.short: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission and stay open after the story. WATCH: start the chain early anyway. [5][2]
trophies.guide: Play Billy's five jobs, which start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, through to his final mission. GTAZone reports the chain stays open after the story, but one source still warns side chains have story-linked windows, so start it early to be safe. [5][2][4]

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission that opens it, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and start Billy's jobs.
Play all five of Billy's jobs in order.
Finish the final mission for Billy; the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.short: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some strands count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) is time-sensitive. [5][2]
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Not every stranger chain counts: GTAZone lists Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not (they have their own trophies). The timing risk is Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 — it carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race it the moment it appears. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. [5][2][3]

steps.t: Work stranger strands across Leonida, checking the trophy counter after each one — only qualifying strands move it.
Count on Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward the 8.
When Race Against Yago appears in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon), save first, then race it at once — it is time-sensitive.
Keep finishing qualifying strands until the counter reads 8 of 8.
This trophy is not part of the 100% checklist, so finish it in cleanup if it is still open.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.short: Complete the final mission for Randy. WATCH: one source warns side chains have story-linked windows, so start it as soon as it unlocks. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Play Randy's questline through to its final mission. One source (TechWiser, via eGamers) warns that the stranger chains behind the five hidden side trophies have windows linked to story progress, so start Randy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. [2][4]

steps.t: Start Randy's questline as soon as it unlocks.
Play Randy's missions through in order.
Finish the final mission for Randy; the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.short: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only. WATCH: one source warns side chains have story-linked windows, so start it as soon as it unlocks. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's questline through to its final mission. The strand is Jason-only, per OutputLag. One source (TechWiser, via eGamers) warns that the stranger chains behind the five hidden side trophies have windows linked to story progress, so start Tyrone's chain as soon as it unlocks. [2][4]

steps.t: Start Tyrone's questline as soon as it unlocks (Jason-only strand).
Play Tyrone's missions through in order.
Finish the final mission for Tyrone; the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia — each spot counts twice that way. The first is a one-time offer in Chapter 1 that disappears with the chapter. Nobody has confirmed whether that one is required, so do it. [1][2][3][4]. Counts differ: guides say 18 for the trophy while the 100% list stops at 15. [3][4]
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations at 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia — each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters. The first meditation is the risk: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house and follow her to the balcony to meditate. That offer disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and no source has confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. The last spot needs both leads playable, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Counts differ between sources: the trophy needs 18, while the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18. [1][2][3][4][5]

steps.t: Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth: find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house.
Follow her to the balcony and accept the optional meditation prompt. It adds 1 to the counter, though it is not a marked spot.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy has popped.
At the marked spots, meditate with both characters: each spot then counts twice.
The last one needs both leads playable, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Counts differ: guides say 18 for the trophy while the 100% list stops at 15.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.short: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting questline is Jason-only and runs through target decks. Which animal is unconfirmed. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Play Bret Vogel's hunting questline — Jason-only, starting after Chapter 2 — through its target decks until you hunt the unique animal it asks for. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, per OutputLag. Which animal the trophy wants is still unconfirmed, so follow Bret's deck prompts rather than hunting at random. [2][4][5]

steps.t: After Chapter 2, start Bret's hunting questline (Jason-only).
Work through Bret's target decks — 15 of them count toward 100%.
Hunt the unique animal Bret's deck asks for with a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.short: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy. [3]
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them — so the trophy is an early milestone on a much longer collectible grind. [3][2]

steps.t: Collect cards across Leonida until one full set is complete.
Complete two more sets — any 3 of the 18 count.
Keep collecting afterward: 100% needs 15 of 18 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.short: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags counts. [5]
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Any mix counts — GTAZone breaks the pool down as 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel rather than saving it all for cleanup, and the same scanning also feeds Whip It Good. [5][3][2]

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app whenever you pass a landmark, curiosity or sculpture.
Scan traffic too — scanning a vehicle counts as discovering it for Whip It Good.
Keep scanning until the counter reads 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.short: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the 10 hardest. [2][3]
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play, and the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80 — so you can skip the 10 hardest ones entirely. [2][3]

steps.t: Open Progress > Challenges and see which ones are already close.
Play normally — many challenges complete on their own during the other trophies.
Mop up the easy ones until the counter reads 50; save the hardest 10 for later or skip them (100% needs 70).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.short: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs bring 4 stars instantly, so pair it with Maximum Withdrawal. [2]
trophies.guide: Get to a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies give you 4 stars straight away, so the cleanest route is to escape a vault job with your partner — that also earns Maximum Withdrawal. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route. [2][4]

steps.t: Call your partner in, then build a 4-star Wanted Level — a bank vault job does it instantly.
Escape the red heat zone with your partner; leaving the flashing search area is not enough.
A train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reported good escape route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.short: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. [2]
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep the heat up between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment; if it still does not pop, GTABase says to rob a fourth. [2][4]

steps.t: Call your partner in before you start.
Rob a shop, then go straight to the next while still wanted — do not let the stars fade.
Rob the third shop, then wait about 30 seconds after leaving it for the trophy to pop.
If it does not pop, rob a fourth shop while still wanted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.short: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts — no need to drive it. [2]
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of collecting cars. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past the trophy. [2][4][5]

steps.t: Use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar vehicles as you drive.
Scan traffic near busy roads — it is the efficient way to find new models.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered; 100% needs 200 of 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.short: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (slow-motion aim, L3+R3 while aiming). Gang enemies count; cops, soldiers and civilians apparently do not. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3+R3 while aiming. Fill Focus before you start, pick a group of gang enemies (the guards at an illegal operation work well), and use an assault rifle. Gang members count; cops, soldiers and civilians apparently do not. Adrenaline extends Focus. [2][4]

steps.t: Fill your Focus meter before the fight.
Find a group of gang enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) with an assault rifle and down 5 of them in the one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.short: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — gates E3 and E4 work — and fly about 1 km away. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. [2]
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. [2][5]

steps.t: Save first — the police come fast once you take the plane.
At VCIA, go to a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy pops once you are clear.
Planes parked out on the airfield do not count — it has to be a bridged gate plane.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. [2]
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino). Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. [2][5]

steps.t: Save first, then travel to Mile Zero Air Station at the far southwest of the map.
Find the tanks parked on the south side of the air station.
Get in a Rhino, drive it and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.short: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun for the back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. [2]
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload and try again. [2][5]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Go to a jewelry store's locked back door and open it with the Snap Gun — never kick it in.
Inside, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and take the contents.
Leave without being seen; if anyone spots you, reload and retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.short: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of 8. Vaults unlock through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. [2]
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults. [1][2][3][5]

steps.t: Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock vaults.
Tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Escape with the loot; the trophy pops once you are clear of the heat, and Hot Together can pop on the same escape.
Repeat until 5 vaults are done; 100% needs all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank vault job counts if you get away. [5]
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape with the loot. GTAZone notes that a bank vault job counts toward this trophy if you get away — so it can pop naturally while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. [5][2]

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road, or work a bank vault job.
Rob the truck and take the loot.
Escape the police with the loot; the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.short: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog from the whole map; flying over the dark patches is the quickest way. [4][5]
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida by clearing the fog from the whole map. Flying over the dark patches is reported to be the quickest method — take a plane and sweep the uncovered areas until the map is fully revealed. [4][5]

steps.t: Open the map and look for the dark, fogged patches you have not visited.
Fly over them — a plane is the fastest way to clear large areas.
Keep going until no fog is left; the trophy pops when the map is fully revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.short: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations. [2]
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way if you are clearing them for A Long Road. [2][5]

steps.t: Find illegal operations on the map and rob them.
Make sure you hit at least one operation per gang — 9 gangs in total.
The trophy pops once all 9 gangs are covered; 100% needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.short: Confirmed method from PowerPyx: an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. [1]
trophies.guide: PowerPyx names the exact spot: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach — buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. [1] The other lists we read still carry this one as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop at that bar, work the other seafront bars on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar; the trophy pops there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.short: Confirmed method from PowerPyx: steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window — Key Cloner required. [1]
trophies.guide: PowerPyx names the exact car and place: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack the Banshee, drive it forward straight through the showroom window and keep driving; it pops a moment later. Only that blue Banshee counts. [1]

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, go to the showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from that mission.
Steal the blue Banshee, drive it forward straight through the showroom window, and keep driving; it pops a moment later.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.short: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: take all three key valuables, then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. [2]
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. [2][5]

steps.t: In Chapter 2, go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn with Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch from the office.
Take the shotgun from the table and blow the office safe open with a Sticky Bomb for the third valuable.
Escape the police; the trophy pops on the escape. Missed a valuable? The operation returns later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.short: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner — the partner trains alongside you. [2]
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — that is the point of the description's partnership. OutputLag reports it should pop when both reach maximum Strength. [2][4][5]

steps.t: Buy a gym membership.
Train Strength at the gym with your partner along — the partner trains alongside you.
Keep training until both Jason and Lucia hit maximum Strength; the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.short: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Single source (GTABase). Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent. [2][4]
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind while you chase the other trophies. This is a single-source figure (GTABase, via eGamers and GTAZone), so treat the 500 as reported, not confirmed. One warning from the same sources: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent. [2][4][5]

steps.t: Play normally — robberies, fights and other profile-changing actions all feed the counter.
Check the Criminal Profile counter as you go; the trophy pops at 500 actions.
Do not grind toward the Irredeemable profile to fill it — that status is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.short: NOT PINNED DOWN YET. 'Second time's the charm' — no guide has confirmed the trigger. PowerPyx's only lead ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. [1][2][3]
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed how this one unlocks. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is only a reading of the words, not a confirmed method. PowerPyx's only lead ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, still unconfirmed. [1] OutputLag, KeenGamer and eGamers all list it among the hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger. It may pop while you play normally; do not trust any specific method until a guide confirms it. [1][2][3][4]

steps.t: No trigger is confirmed. PowerPyx's only lead ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; a 'second try' success somewhere is the other guess.
If a robbery or activity fails once, retry it rather than reloading an old save — a retry success is the best guess.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Confirmed method from PowerPyx: the UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. [1]
trophies.guide: PowerPyx pins it to the UFO easter egg: go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2AM, look for a blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns — then follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO and help the woman it drops back to her car. [1] The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

steps.t: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns.
Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.short: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by. The description gives the method; the precise trigger is still being confirmed — PowerPyx's lead is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. [1][3]
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The description itself gives the method, but KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so treat the details (which weapon, which target, how many) as unconfirmed and try the obvious version first. PowerPyx's current belief is that it comes from kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. [1][3][2]

steps.t: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon ready.
Drive past a pedestrian and hit them with the melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
If it does not pop, try it on a motorcycle — PowerPyx's lead is kicking enemies while riding one. The precise trigger is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.short: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. The bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and Yasmani pays the most. [2][5]
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills by selling them to your contacts. The bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and the total grows during the 100% robberies — GTAZone reports Yasmani pays the most. The 100% checklist also wants $250,000 in marked bills fenced, so this trophy and A Long Road share the same grind. [2][5][3]

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from bank and payday loan jobs.
Sell them to your contacts to launder them — Yasmani pays the most, per GTAZone.
Keep going until the cumulative total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Every kind of shop counts. [2]
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across every kind of shop. The total is cumulative across all shops, so normal spending on gear, garages and supplies adds up — and the big garage purchases for Little Boxes help. [2][5]

steps.t: Spend normally across shops as you play — the total is cumulative.
If you are short at the end, buy the 8 garages for Little Boxes or stock up on gear until the counter reads $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.short: Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count. The app unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. [2]
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 for sale do. [2][4][5]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy garages through the app until you own all 8 for sale (about $160,000 total).
Story garages do not count — only the 8 purchased ones do.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.short: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. [2]
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars. [2][5]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 mission Moses to open the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garage space first — each registered car needs a free space.
Take a stolen (preferably cheap) car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray works too.
